emails.body: The public moment is a livestream launch night; you on camera, walking everyone through the new ACME. We're running it {!launch_livestream = dom:10,+2m @19:00-20:00}. Get the launch livestream blocked.
emails.subject: The Launch livestream

emails.body: I want you in the green room an hour before the livestream for a mic check and a last run of the talking points. Block the hour right before it as green room.
emails.subject: Green room before we go live

emails.body: We've got the downtown billboard reveal staged for 11 AM on launch day: big crowd photo op right after the site goes live. Hold {dom:10,+2m @11:00-11:30} for the billboard unveiling.
emails.subject: Billboard photo op

emails.body: Bad news on the billboard. The city pulled our outdoor assembly permit this morning and there's no appeal in time. Kill the billboard unveiling, we can't hold a crowd there legally.
emails.subject: Billboard's off

emails.body: The board and a few key investors will want hard launch numbers fast, traffic, conversion, sell-through. I need a clean metrics readout compiled three days after we go live, by {dom:13,+2m @17:00}.
emails.subject: Metrics readout

emails.body: Saw the teasers floating around, congratulations on the bold new direction! While I have you, we'd love to provide a quote for refreshed in-store signage to match. Happy to send a deck whenever.
emails.subject: Congrats on the relaunch!

emails.body: It's live!!!
emails.subject: We are live!

emails.body: Whatever the numbers say, this team ran through walls. Let's do a launch team thank-you lunch the day after we go live, at {@launch_livestream+1d @12:00-13:00}. Get it on the calendar before everyone scatters.
emails.subject: Thank the team

emails.body:
Hey Mark,

Kicking off this year's innovation pitch competition starting next week. Teams will be working on new product concepts for about a month, then we'll do the final pitch event on {!pitch_final = dom:15,+1m @14:00-16:00}. There'll be a few smaller showcases along the way too, will send those as they come up.

Excited to see what people come up with this year.

VP Product
emails.subject: Pitch comp is on, locking in the final date

emails.body:
Thanks Mark, makes sense. I'll keep you off the calendar for the team showcases and just have you down for the final. Will loop you back in closer to the date.

VP Product
emails.subject: Pitch comp is on, locking in the final date

emails.body:
Hey Mark, one more ask. Could we grab a slot with the board about a week after the final, so we can walk them through whatever wins? Same time as the final would be ideal if it works for you, just makes it easier to plan around.

VP Product
emails.subject: Board slot the week after finals?

emails.body:
Hey Mark, quick update, kickoff this morning went great and we've got five teams signed up already. Attaching the agenda and team list for you, nothing needed from you, just wanted you in the loop.

Operations
emails.subject: Kickoff went well

emails.body:
Hey Mark, we're doing the semifinal showcase next week, three teams presenting early concepts. Totally optional but if you've got time we'd love to have you swing by for even 15 minutes.

Design Lead
emails.subject: Come check out the semifinal showcase?

emails.body:
Hey Mark, we're running a quick prep session with the judging panel before the final to align on scoring criteria. Figured I'd ask in case you wanted to sit in, no pressure either way.

Business Development
emails.subject: Judges prep session, want in?

emails.body:
Hey Mark, we're doing a quick mid-point check-in with all five teams this Thursday, mostly just progress updates and Q&A. Happy to send you the notes afterward if you can't make it.

Operations
emails.subject: Mid-comp check-in with the teams

emails.body:
Hey Mark, we're putting together a small mixer with a couple of our retail partners the night before the final, mostly informal. Would be great if you could make an appearance but completely understand if your schedule's packed.

VP Marketing
emails.subject: Sponsor mixer before the final

emails.body:
Hey Mark, we're doing a quick internal budget review for the pitch comp spend so far, nothing major, just making sure we're tracking against plan. You're welcome to join if you want visibility but it's not necessary.

Finance
emails.subject: Pitch comp budget review, optional sit-in

emails.body:
Hey Mark, a few of us are organizing a casual lunch for everyone involved in the pitch comp, just a small thank you for the extra hours people are putting in. Would be a nice touch if you could pop by but totally understand if you can't.

Head of HR
emails.subject: Team morale lunch during the comp

emails.body:
Hey Mark, just confirming you're still good for the final on the date we locked in. Also wanted to flag, the day before we're doing a full dry run with all five teams back to back, probably useful context if you wanted to drop in but no obligation at all.

VP Product
emails.subject: Quick reminder on the final

emails.body:
Hey Mark, just confirming you're still good for the final on the date we locked in. Also wanted to flag, the day before we're doing a full dry run with all five teams back to back, probably useful context if you wanted to drop in but no obligation at all.

VP Product
emails.subject: Quick reminder on the final

emails.body:
Hey Mark, we've got a small press preview set up the morning of the final, giving a couple of trade outlets early access to the concepts under embargo. You're not needed for it but wanted to keep you posted since it's the same day.

Communications / PR
emails.subject: Press preview ahead of the final

emails.body:
Hey Mark, VP Product and I want to grab some time with you to go over the pitch comp budget, mainly the prize money and event costs. Could we lock in {!budget_meeting = dom:1,+1m @10:00-11:00} for that?

Finance
emails.subject: Need a budget meeting for the pitch comp

emails.body:
Hey Mark, sorry for the shuffle, can we move the budget meeting to {!budget_meeting_new = dom:8,+1m @10:00-11:00} instead? A couple of us have a conflict come up on the original date.

VP Product
emails.subject: Need to push the budget meeting

emails.body: Hey Mark, I want to make the full case for the rebrand before we take it further. Can you get a vision sync on your calendar for {!vision_sync = dom:15,0m @10:00-11:00}? I'll bring the whole deck. I'm also pushing for the public reveal to land on {!rebrand_reveal = dom:10,+1m}.
emails.subject: Rebrand pitch

emails.body: Mark, exciting stuff in the works! But Policy is clear that anything this size needs board sign-off before we spend a dollar. You'll want at least three board members in the room. Can you get a board sign-off meeting on the books for {!board_signoff = dom:11,+0m @14:00-15:00}
emails.subject: Might be too much $$$

emails.body: I'm traveling Thursday; no can do. Can we push it to {dom:15,+0m @14:00-15:00}, same time of day?
emails.subject: Can't do thursday...

emails.body: The trademark search on the new ACME logo came back clean- no conflicts. Just wanted it in your hands before the board meets.
emails.subject: ACME trademark clear

emails.body: The board can't approve a number they haven't read. I need the rebrand budget memo finalized and on my desk the day before {dom:15,+0m @14:00-15:00}, end of day at the latest.
emails.subject: Memo before the board sits

emails.body: Mark, we're good to go!
emails.subject: Locked in for sign-off meeting

emails.body:
It's official: the new site goes live on {dom:10,+2m @09:00-09:30}. That's the moment everything else hangs off of, so treat {!launch_day = dom:10,+2m} as fixed. 

Also need your sign-off on a couple of things that I will be sending through momentarily; get them done by{dom:3,+2m}!
emails.subject: Launch day locked

emails.body: Press embargo lifts at {@launch_day @06:00-06:30}, three hours ahead of the site, so the coverage is up first. Block that on your calendar as the embargo lift so nobody schedules over it.
emails.subject: Embargo lifts at six

emails.body: No more changes to the hero film or the campaign stills after the freeze. I need everything final and handed to production by {@launch_day-1w}, end of day at the latest. Put a task on me so it doesn't slip.
emails.subject: Design locked

emails.body: Every retail floor gets stripped and re-skinned to the new branding the night before we go live, {@launch_day-1d @20:00-23:00}, so customers walk into the new era Monday morning. Block the floor reset so the regional leads see it locked.
emails.subject: Store floors reset overnight

emails.body: I want a full dress rehearsal of the site flip before the real thing, the whole team on the call watching the cutover end to end. Hold {dom:6,+2m @10:00-11:00} for the launch dry run.
emails.subject: Dry run of the flip

emails.body: Hey Mark, I want to walk you through a teaser plan so that the rebrand doesn't give whiplash. Does {dom:30,0m @11:00-11:45} work for you?
emails.subject: Teaser campaign?

emails.body: I've sold ACME boots for 22 years to people who trust exactly what this name has always stood for. This futuristic relaunch feels like we're throwing all of that away for a trend. I'm asking leadership, please, rethink it before it's too late.
emails.subject: Please reconsider this rebrand

emails.body: Hey Mark, heard that PR wants a slow warm-up. I think that's a big mistake. The impact here lies in shock value; teasers would ruin that. My recommendation is that we go completely dark until {!acme_reveal = dom:10,+2m}.
emails.subject: Hard no on teasers

emails.body: Got your decision, we go cold, no teasers. I disagree but it's your call and I'm behind it. No reason to keep the teaser review on the books, so we can cancel that.
emails.subject: Standing down on teasers

emails.body: I've got a steady stream of worried people at my door about the rebrand, and it's turning into a real retention risk. Can we grab 45 minutes on {!HR_morale_sync = dom:10,+1m}?
emails.subject: We need to talk about morale

emails.body: Following our chat, the cleanest fix is one company-wide webinar where you lay out the why directly. Run it a few days before the reveal so it's fresh going into launch week. I think three days before {@acme_reveal} at {dom:7,+2m @10:00-11:00} would be optimal, so let's set our calendars for that.
emails.subject: All-hands to get everyone aligned

emails.body: Here's the rundown of your media push: It all builds to the reveal on {!reveal = dom:10,+2m}. First up is the cover-story interview, {dom:6,+2m @14:00-15:00}. Will follow up shortly with more details.
emails.subject: Press plan for launch

emails.body: We got you the anchor slot on the national morning show the day we go live, {@reveal @07:00-07:30}. Block it as the morning show so nothing else creeps onto launch-day breakfast.
emails.subject: Morning show, launch day

emails.body: The big business podcast, "mind your own business" wants you the week before launch. Any of these afternoons works, pick one: {dom:3,+2m @09:00-10:00}, {dom:4,+2m}, or {dom:5,+2m}, 3-4 PM each.

emails.body:
Hey Mark,

Happy to report, I’ve talked to our lead of design Melissa and it looks like the new batch of shoe designs for Acme will be ready very soon. Afterwards, I will arrange some final look-overs and then we can start producing the new shoes! Let me know if you have any questions.

Thanks,
Damien
emails.subject: Product launch ready soon!

emails.body:
Hi Mark,

Unfortunately this second batch of shoes’ designs were not completed in time. I understand we scheduled the release for next week but there were some internal conflicts within our department.

I assure you we will have the designs ready in two weeks and at the same time, our marketing lead will work on advertisements. I believe Josh wanted you to double check his work the day he's done, could you please do that? He said it would be ready on {!advertising_ready = dom:15,0m}.

P.S. I also wanted to discuss privately with you the future of the design team to ensure these internal conflicts never happen again. Let’s schedule a meeting, I was thinking {!melissa_meeting_1 = this:WED @18:00-19:00}.

Best,
Melissa
emails.subject: Design delays - internal conflicts

emails.body:
Hello Mark,

Our budget has been exceeded by 20% and projected to cost even more since we haven’t done advertising yet.

We really need another week to discuss this budget problem. I understand the advertising was suppose to launch on {dom:15,0m} but we need to push this back to {dom:22,0m}. Let’s reschedule that back a week to the 22nd of this month, and we’ll have a budget meeting on {!budget_meeting_bill = dom:15,0m @17:00-18:00} instead.

It’s also good to have another meeting every two weeks. For now, let’s schedule one for {!second_bill_meeting = dom:29,0m}.

Thank you,
Bill

I spoke with Melissa as I believe you have too. We came to the agreement that half their team is effectively non-productive.

Let’s schedule a meeting {!design_cut_meeting = serve+3d} to discuss who we can let go.

Before then, can you have 1-2 people in mind? I’m thinking between Alice, Drake, and Bobby.

Thanks,
Damien

Thanks,
Damien

Thanks,
Josh
